tools.name: peer_send_message
tools.description:
Send a message to a peer A2A agent and wait up to timeout_seconds (45 by default, 50 at most) for the result.
Returns {task_id, context_id, state, response?, parts?, artifacts?}. If state is 'working', the peer is still on it: keep polling with peer_get_task(task_id). If state is 'input-required' or 'auth-required', the peer is waiting on you: answer it with peer_send_message in the same context_id.
For work expected to take longer, prefer peer_start_task + peer_get_task from the start so you stay responsive.

context_id.description: A context_id an earlier call returned, to continue that conversation with the peer.

name.description: The peer's name, as peer_list gives it.

parts.description: A2A message parts to send instead of prompt.

prompt.description: The text to send. Give this or parts.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the peer's result; a longer wait is capped at 50 seconds.

tools.name: peer_cancel_task
tools.description: Request cancellation of an in-flight peer task. Returns the task's final state. Fails if the task is already in a terminal state.

task_id.description: The task_id peer_send_message or peer_start_task returned.

tools.name: peer_start_task
tools.description: Start a peer A2A task and return immediately without waiting for it to finish. Returns {task_id, context_id, state}. You must then call peer_get_task(task_id) repeatedly until state is one of 'completed' | 'failed' | 'canceled' | 'rejected'. If state becomes 'input-required' or 'auth-required', the peer is waiting on you: stop polling and answer it with peer_send_message in the task's context_id.

context_id.description: A context_id an earlier call returned, to continue that conversation with the peer.

name.description: The peer's name, as peer_list gives it.

parts.description: A2A message parts to send instead of prompt.

prompt.description: The text to send. Give this or parts.

tools.name: peer_get_task
tools.description: Fetch the current state of a peer task by id. Returns {state, response?, parts?, artifacts?, history?, error?}. Call repeatedly (with a small delay between calls) until state is terminal ('completed', 'failed', 'canceled', or 'rejected'). 'input-required' or 'auth-required' means the peer is waiting on you: stop polling and answer it with peer_send_message in the task's context_id.

history_length.description: How many of the task's messages to return.

task_id.description: The task_id peer_send_message or peer_start_task returned.

tools.name: peer_list
tools.description: Return the routing table of available peer A2A agents. Each entry has name, description, skills, default input/output modes, and supported capabilities. Call this before peer_send_message / peer_start_task to choose the right peer.
